records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Hey, @.#$e#I always knew we would become good friends. It was written in the stars!|Hi, @.$u#$e#I always knew we'd become close like this...
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#嘿，@。#$e#我一直知道我們會成為好朋友。這是命中注定的！|嗨，@。$u#$e#我一直知道我們會變得這麼親近……

records.source: I hope you're farming in a sustainable way. The valley's ecosystem is fragile!#$e#How do I know? I have a strong gut-feeling!
records.translation: 希望你用永續的方式經營農場。山谷的生態系統很脆弱！#$e#我怎麼知道？我的直覺很強烈！

records.source: Sometimes the flowers speak to me... each one has a different story to tell!
records.translation: 有時花朵會對我說話……每一朵都有不同的故事！

records.source: Ah, spring. The season of pastels. I actually prefer jewel tones, myself.#$b#Oh, excuse me! I was mumbling about fashion again, wasn't I?
records.translation: 啊，春天。粉彩色的季節。其實我個人比較喜歡寶石色。#$b#喔，不好意思！我又在喃喃自語地談時尚了，對吧？

records.source: I like making my own clothes, but it's not easy to get cloth.#$e#And it's such a long trip to the city.
records.translation: 我喜歡自己做衣服，但布料不容易取得。#$e#而且去一趟城市路途很遠。

records.source: Do you ever think about the texture of fabric, @? Each texture has a distinct personality... feel my dress... see?
records.translation: @，你會思考布料的質感嗎？每種質感都有鮮明的個性……摸摸我的洋裝……感覺到了嗎？

records.source: Hi @!#$e#Do you raise sheep in your barn? You can turn their wool into beautiful bolts of cloth!#$e#You'll need a loom, though. You can make them yourself if you know the crafting recipe.
records.translation: 嗨，@！#$e#你的畜棚裡有養綿羊嗎？可以把牠們的羊毛織成一匹匹漂亮的布！#$e#不過你需要織布機。只要知道製作配方，就能自己做一台。

records.source: This house was left in our care by my parents. They've been traveling the world for the last two years.#$e#We have no idea when they'll be back.#$e#I enjoy living here, though. It's a beautiful area and the town is nice.
records.translation: 父母把這棟房子交給我們照看。他們這兩年一直在環遊世界。#$e#我們完全不知道他們什麼時候回來。#$e#不過我很喜歡住在這裡。這一帶景色很美，鎮上也很宜人。

records.source: Thank you!
records.translation: 謝謝你！

records.source: Um... Okay. Sorry you didn't like it. I guess those three years of practice were a complete waste...$s
records.translation: 嗯……好吧。很抱歉你不喜歡。看來那三年的練習全都白費了……$s

records.source: Did you really think so? That's exactly the effect I was shooting for!$h#$b#I'm so glad you liked it.
records.translation: 你真的這麼覺得嗎？那正是我想呈現的效果！$h#$b#你喜歡真是太好了。

records.source: Haley is a picky eater. It's so hard to cook for her.
records.translation: 海莉很挑食。要做飯給她吃真不容易。

records.source: Eating healthy is very important to me. I want to live a long and active life.
records.translation: 健康飲食對我非常重要。我想長壽，並且一生都充滿活力。

records.source: Haley and I get along much better now that she's moved out. I look forward to her visits!
records.translation: 海莉搬出去後，我們相處得好多了。我很期待她回來看我！

records.source: Hello there, @.#$e#I feel lazy today.$u
records.translation: 你好啊，@。#$e#我今天懶洋洋的。$u

records.source: I feel bad for Linus. People judge him, but he's just living a different lifestyle.$u#$e#I wish everyone could learn to be accepting of others.
records.translation: 我替萊納斯感到難過。人們會批判他，但他只是過著不同的生活。$u#$e#真希望大家都能學會接納他人。

records.source: Hi, @! We've become decent friends, haven't we?$h#$e#That's fine with me. You're a cool guy.^I'm glad.$h
records.translation: 嗨，@！我們已經成為不錯的朋友了，對吧？$h#$e#我很樂意。你是個很酷的男生。^真高興。$h

records.source: Hi, @! We've become decent friends, haven't we?$h#$e#This may sound weird, but I've always been certain this would happen.
records.translation: 嗨，@！我們已經成為不錯的朋友了，對吧？$h#$e#這聽起來也許很奇怪，但我一直確信會有這一天。

records.source: It doesn't rain much in summer, does it?#$e#That just means more watering work for you, huh?#$e#Or do you enjoy the sunny weather?
records.translation: 夏天不太下雨，對吧？#$e#這表示你得花更多工夫澆水，是不是？#$e#還是你其實喜歡晴朗的天氣？

records.source: I consider the bees and butterflies to be my special friends!
records.translation: 我把蜜蜂和蝴蝶視為特別的朋友！

records.source: If I wasn't so busy I'd come help you on the farm!#$e#But Gus would be upset if I had another job...$s
records.translation: 如果不是這麼忙，我就會去農場幫你！#$e#但如果我又做另一份工作，格斯會不高興的……$s

records.source: You know, I'm sure Gus would understand if I wanted to leave the Saloon someday.#$b#There's so much out there, I can't stay a barmaid forever.$u
records.translation: 你知道嗎，如果有一天我想離開酒館，格斯一定會理解。#$b#外面的世界那麼廣闊，我不能永遠當酒吧女服務生。$u

records.source: Don't overwork yourself or you might end up in Harvey's clinic!
records.translation: 別工作過度，否則你可能會進哈維的診所！

records.source: Hi @!
It's around this time of year that my good friends visit the region... I mean the parrots!
records.translation: 每年大約這個時候，我的好朋友就會來到這一帶……我是說鸚鵡！

records.source: Well, fall is here. Time to plant some new crops, huh?
records.translation: 嗯，秋天到了。該種些新作物了，對吧？

records.source: $d bus#I'm visiting Sandy today. We're best friends!#$e#I'm really happy that the bus is repaired.|*Sigh*... If only that old bus were fixed, I would've visited my friend Sandy today...$s
records.translation: $d bus#我今天要去拜訪珊迪。我們是最好的朋友！#$e#公車修好了，我真的很開心。|*嘆氣*……要是那輛舊公車修好了，我今天就能去拜訪朋友珊迪……$s

records.source: It's good weather for a picnic, isn't it?
records.translation: 這天氣很適合野餐，對吧？

records.source: If I didn't have to work I'd suggest we go on a nice picnic!
records.translation: 如果不用工作，我就會提議一起去愉快地野餐！

records.source: Hello. Did you have a good summer?
records.translation: 你好。這個夏天過得愉快嗎？

records.source: Hi @! I bet your farm did great this past summer, huh?#$e#You're an excellent farmer.$h
records.translation: 嗨，@！我敢說你的農場今年夏天經營得很成功，對吧？#$e#你是位出色的農夫。$h

records.source: My friend runs a shop in the desert. If you ever go there stop in and say hi for me.#$e#I think she sells some rare products.
records.translation: 我的朋友在沙漠裡開店。如果你去那裡，記得順道替我問候她。#$e#她好像會賣一些稀有商品。

records.source: Are you friends with Clint? He's a nice guy, if you get to know him.#$e#He gets lonely working in his shop all day. But he's so shy he has trouble making new friends.
records.translation: 你和克林特是朋友嗎？深入認識後，就會發現他人很好。#$e#他整天在店裡工作，感到很寂寞。但他太害羞，很難結交新朋友。

records.source: I think Clint's mad at me. He never looks at me anymore...$u#$e#I always thought we were friends.$u
records.translation: 我覺得克林特在生我的氣。他再也不看我了……$u#$e#我一直以為我們是朋友。$u

records.source: Another beautiful fall day.#$e#It's a pity it'll soon be over.
records.translation: 又是美好的秋日。#$e#可惜這樣的日子很快就要結束了。

records.source: Smell that clean air? It's lovely, isn't it?#$b#I just fear that the Joja Co.'s of the world will take this away from us.$u
records.translation: 聞到那清新的空氣了嗎？很美好，對吧？#$b#我只是擔心世上的 Joja 公司會把這一切從我們身邊奪走。$u

records.source: Keep your mind open and some interesting things might take root.#$e#Anyway, how is your day going?
records.translation: 保持開放的心，說不定會有有趣的事物生根發芽。#$e#話說回來，你今天過得如何？

records.source: I don't have any huge plans for life. I prefer not to stress about the future.
records.translation: 我對人生沒有什麼宏大的計畫。我比較喜歡不為未來操心。

records.source: Nothing like a sunny Sunday to lift the spirits!
records.translation: 沒有什麼比陽光明媚的星期日更能振奮精神！

records.source: There's so many invisible barriers holding us back. Why can't people learn to let go and explore their true potential?#$e#Me? Well, you know what they say... 'You can't cage a wild Junimo'.
records.translation: 有太多無形的障礙束縛著我們。人們為什麼不能學會放手，探索真正的潛能？#$e#我嗎？嗯，你知道人們常說……「狂野的祝尼魔是關不住的」。

records.source: You're such a nice person, @! Thanks for being my friend.$h
records.translation: @，你真是個好人！謝謝你成為我的朋友。$h

records.source: Be careful an icicle doesn't fall on your head!
records.translation: 小心冰柱別掉到你頭上！

records.source: Be careful an icicle doesn't fall on your head! I wouldn't want you to get hurt!
records.translation: 小心冰柱別掉到你頭上！我不希望你受傷！

records.source: Oh, hello @!$h#$e#You must be getting very good at farming by now, huh?
records.translation: 喔，你好，@！$h#$e#你現在一定很擅長務農了，對吧？

records.source: I bet you're an excellent farmer by now!
records.translation: 我敢說你現在已經是位出色的農夫了！

records.source: I think my hair is frozen solid...$s
records.translation: 我的頭髮好像凍得硬梆梆的……$s

records.source: Haley and I aren't made for such a big house. It's a hassle to keep it clean.#$e#Ah well. I really shouldn't be complaining.#$e#Your farmhouse seems nice and cozy.$h
records.translation: 海莉和我不適合住這麼大的房子。維持整潔很麻煩。#$e#唉，算了。我真的不該抱怨。#$e#你的農舍看起來舒適又溫馨。$h

records.source: It must be so cold for the poor fish.$s#$e#I wonder if any fish hibernate? Maybe I should ask Demetrius.
records.translation: 那些可憐的魚一定冷極了。$s#$e#不知道有沒有魚會冬眠？也許我該問問德米特里厄斯。

records.source: If I wasn't so busy I'd help you dig around in that cave by the lake.#$e#I bet there are some powerful crystals inside there.
records.translation: 如果不是這麼忙，我就會去湖邊的洞穴幫你挖掘。#$e#我敢說裡面有些能量強大的水晶。

records.source: Do you know how to cook 'Bean Hotpot'?#$e#I like that dish quite a bit.$h%revealtaste:Emily:207#$e#It's hard to get fresh ingredients in the winter, huh?
records.translation: 你會做「豆子火鍋」嗎？#$e#我很喜歡那道菜。$h%revealtaste:Emily:207#$e#冬天很難取得新鮮食材，對吧？

records.source: Hi!#$e#...Yes?
records.translation: 嗨！#$e#……怎麼了？

records.source: My sister and I might fight sometimes, but I would really miss her if she left.#$e#I think she'll become a very nice young lady some day... Don't tell her I said that.$h#$e#So, is there anything you want to talk about?
records.translation: 我和妹妹有時會吵架，但如果她離開，我一定會非常想念她。#$e#我覺得她有一天會成為很棒的年輕女性……別告訴她這是我說的。$h#$e#所以，你有什麼想聊的嗎？

records.source: Say hi to my sister for me! And remind her to visit me tomorrow.
records.translation: 替我向妹妹問好！也提醒她明天來看我。
